citation: Scala et al. 2025. Analysis of the effect of 6‐Hz binaural beats on electroencephalographic and autonomic parameters of healthy individuals: An exploratory study. Physiological Reports
protocol: Resting-state recording of 10 min lying on a bed, eyes closed, before and during auditory stimulation (6-Hz binaural beats); respiratory rate in the resting-state condition
note: Resting-state mean 18.9 +/- 3.9 with median (IQR); lying posture stated. The rest is with auditory stimulation in other blocks; the resting-state block is the usable one. Sex not checked.
